notes.title: Unmatched: Digital Edition update 1.2.1 is here!

[b]Update 1.2.1[/b] for Unmatched: Digital Edition is now live! We've been listening closely to your feedback and have addressed several bugs that our community reported. Thank you for your support and for helping us improve the game.

[QoL] Added a localization key for the server message "User name is already in use" for all languages.
[Fix] Resolved an issue where Dracula's AI could crash when defeated in 2v2 games.
[Fix] Fixed an issue preventing the "1001 Nights" achievement from unlocking properly.
[Fix] Addressed a bug where Dracula could select illegal cards when playing the "Do My Bidding" card against Mr. Jekyll / Dr. Hyde.
[Fix] Fixed a crash that occurred when AI attempted to use the "Ravening Seduction" card.
[Fix] Resolved a crash issue that happened when undoing actions of the Invisible Man.

That's all for today! Challenge each other on Unmatched maps and enjoy the game! We're eager to hear from you, so feel free to drop a comment or leave feedback using the in-game feedback feature!

notes.title: Unmatched: Digital Edition has been released!
notes.content:
[h1]Unmatched: Digital Edition has been released![/h1]
That's right! As of this moment, you can enjoy Unmatched: Digital Edition in its full version! Read below to see what has changed and what are our plans regarding this game in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/2a4b4d03ee39a6ce40db665d13c9863802bc9b16.png[/img]

[h1]Two new characters and one map have been added to the game![/h1]
We would like to introduce to you Little Red and Beowulf as well as the Heorot - the new battlefield with an exciting mechanic! You are getting them as part of the base game - that means for free!

[h2][b]Little Red[/b] [/h2]
Little Red features a clever card-combo mechanism. Matching icons on the cards she plays to the one in her "basket" (discard pile), triggers potent effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/ac0e5dd5cc3b870bcaccb864a3f4b54c783f7ccf.png[/img]

[b]Starting Health: [/b]14
[b]Attack:[/b] Melee
[b]Move value:[/b] 2
[b]Sidekick:[/b] Huntsman

[b]Special Ability: [/b]Resolve an effect on a card you play if the symbol next to the effect matches the item in your basket.
When your discard pile is empty, you have [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/ae2e188dcd42ac2dbb41a84a63453bc7b6305708.png[/img] [b](wild symbol)[/b] in your basket.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/b74d21f9e7961b1bdce22232dbcda32e294b667b.png[/img]

1. Item in your basket when the card is on top of your discard pile.
2. Card effect available while playing the card, if its symbol matches the item in your basket.

Below you can see all the Little Red symbols:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/79a0a5247a0eb35dd4451c71fba1f1ab9998685e.png[/img]

[h2][b]Beowulf[/b][/h2]
Beowulf uses rage to power up his cards for devastating attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/0d1a1f3281f286bd799faf6044d1814981db0b94.png[/img]

[b]Starting Health:[/b] 17
[b]Attack: [/b]Melee
[b]Move value: [/b]2
[b]Sidekick:[/b] Wiglaf

[b]Special Ability: [/b]Beowulf can spend Rage for the effects of certain cards. Gaining Rage will trigger if Beowulf is dealt damage from any source, even from an ally. Icon of special ability in the player’s panel shows the current amount of Beowulf’s Rage:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/6144b8ceb683aa1c616a9920edc0d64e58efa289.png[/img]

Beowulf starts with 1 Rage.
When Beowulf is dealt damage, he gains 1 Rage.
Beowulf has a maximum of 3 Rage.

[h2][b]Heorot[/b][/h2]
Heorot is a brand new battlefield with [b]the exciting door mechanism[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/2131b7e170e6044f7cec5aeb93240c87f53ff578.png[/img]

Doors are an additional element on the battlefield that fighters can interact with. Their number and placement depend on the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/debb8c71883e28a6f9e4b2a64d7bdc4cf8cfe732.jpg[/img]

Doors can be opened or closed (the game starts with all doors open). When the door is closed, treat any lines crossing the door as if they did not exist. This blocks movement and attacks eliminates adjacency and breaks up zones. Two spaces that would normally be in the same zone are treated as if they are in different zones if there is a closed door on the shortest path between them.

[h1]More characters and maps are coming![/h1]

We are going to release a lot of DLCs - both heroes and maps - the first 2 comes in March!
You can[b] get all of them[/b] as soon as they are released and [b]with over 50% discount [/b]- just buy Season Pass! It's the best way to have a full experience of Unmatched [b]at the best price possible![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2006720/Unmatched_Digital_Edition_Season_Pass_1/

[h2][b]You can see our release schedule below![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/24e1b065598b68c8ecc46cd9d7338c4e6f6d7d90.png[/img]

[h1]Free skins for Early Access players![/h1]

[b]As promised all Early Access players received a special set of skins for free![/b] We are talking about Contrast Skin Bundles 1 and 2! Below you can see how they look in-game!

[h2]Contrast Skin Bundle 1[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/b465f5a0aa1c7bfaf5c6175654b2dc5835dda8f2.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2313510

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/eb1c878e31c1e87699b778b91f6bf358246180d8.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2325630

We would like to thank you again for your participation in Unmatched: Digital Edition Early Access on Steam! Your feedback and input helped us create the amazing game that Unmatched: Digital Edition is today!

[h1]We have added new skin bundles![/h1]

THAT'S NOT ALL! [b]On the launch day,[/b] we are also making available for you a very cool set of skins [b]based on the 80s style![/b] Groovy!

[h2]80s Skin Bundle 1[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/a0bc3c9946636f02c02e98224d706aeef12ceced.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2313511

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/8c7e39072fa465177295458e19ba0083bf3237ce.png[/img]

[h1]We have also updated the game![/h1]
One thing we at Acram can promise you is that after the release we will keep constantly working on providing you with the best Unmatched experience! We are listening to the feedback you are sending to us and in case of any in-game issues - are fixing them asap! Stay assured that we will keep this attitude after the release by updating the game on regular basis!

[h2][b]Version 1.0.0 changelog: [/b][/h2]

You can access it from the main menu. There you can see all released and to-be-released characters, skins, and maps! Additionally, you can also check out the character's deck from there so you know what you might stand against (or play with) in your future games! Expand your collection with individual DLCs or [b]simply buy Season Pass and get all of them with a 50% discount![/b]

Someone has been mean to you or used inappropriate language (despite our profanity check feature)? Now you can report that player and we will investigate the issue. Let's keep our community as friendly as possible and hope that our new feature will not be necessary very often!

We have encountered this problem and you also have provided us with extremally helpful feedback on this issue! We have fixed it and now you can move on the board as much as you can - of course according to the rules.

That's all! Now go and try new heroes and the Heorot map. Compete with each other,  try new ways to play, and just enjoy Unmatched: Digital Edition - [b]It's a special day - the full release day![/b] Let’s play now!

Also please share with us in the comments how you like Unmatched: Digital Edition!

[h1]Unmatched: Digital Edition is coming![/h1]
We are happy to announce that the full release of Unmatched: Digital Edition will take place on[b] the 28th of February 2023[/b]! Additionally, if you are already an Early Access player - you will get [b]a special skin for all characters (DLCs included)[/b] as a thank-you gift! It's still not too late to join the Early Access group! :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/72465d42d37e4a7941cb34a17fefa0b72273b8f8.png[/img]
Better not to get lost in the Yukon Forest. Who knows what lives in there?
Bigfoot and his pal, the Jackalope, crash through the forest for quick attacks before disappearing like a figment of the mind!

[b]Starting Health:[/b] 16
[b]Attack:[/b] Melee
[b]Move value:[/b] 3
[b]Sidekick:[/b] The Jackalope

[b]Special Ability:[/b] At the end of your turn, if there are no opposing fighters in Bigfoot's zone, you may draw 1 card.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/4343a5515bb744b19d87c55c2e63a65829af1d6f.png[/img]
You know him, you love him - a brave archer from Sherwood Forest!
Robin Hood and his outlaws excel at ranged attacks and robbing their opponents!

[b]Starting Health:[/b] 13
[b]Attack:[/b] Ranged
[b]Move value:[/b] 2
[b]Sidekick:[/b] Four Outlaws

[b]Special Ability:[/b] After you attack, you may move your attacking fighter up to 2 spaces.


[h1]Yukon - April 2023[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/9186dc2fa40dff710ce2b85eb1e6bd78d96410f7.png[/img]
Yukon - wild and mountainous territory, the Yukon makes for a tight fight - beware of getting trapped in a trail loop!

[h1]Dracula - April 2023[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/a01eabcf96a8c6a6e30e49d171bbdcc117208f5a.png[/img]
Better close your windows for the night!
Dracula and the Sisters slowly drain you of your power!

[b]Starting Health:[/b] 13
[b]Attack:[/b] Melee
[b]Move value:[/b] 2
[b]Sidekick:[/b] Three Sisters

[b]Special Ability:[/b] At the start of your turn, you may deal 1 damage to a fighter adjacent to Dracula. If you do, draw a card.


[h1]Sherlock Holmes - May 2023[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/7f54d70d0fe1f4e05bcb5cc66b275e95a878e598.png[/img]
Sherlock, with the trusty Watson by his side, schemes and calculates to ensure victory!

[b]Starting Health:[/b] 16
[b]Attack:[/b] Melee
[b]Move value:[/b] 2
[b]Sidekick:[/b] Dr. Watson

[b]Special Ability:[/b] Effects on HOLMES and DR. WATSON cards cannot be canceled by an opponent. (Effects on ANY cards can be canceled.)


[h1]Sherwood Forest - May 2023[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/c30fa44e697c662a76600bdb8ab8841c0c89c1b1.png[/img]
Sherwood Forest - the royal forest in Nottinghamshire, savvy melee fighters can take down even the most skilled ranged attackers!

Sherwood Forest is a map dedicated for 1v1 games!


[h1]Soho - June 2023[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/90aa0397a80436adf03530fc2ad39d87d14235f1.png[/img]
Soho - home to Mr. Edward Hyde, leap from rooftops and work the range to your advantage!

[h1]Jekyll & Hyde - June 2023[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/ae134bf774e9a25c2a692d564b01078f16e53c1a.png[/img]
Jekyll & Hyde uses the former's cunning and the latter's brute strength to win the day!

[b]Starting Health:[/b] 16
[b]Attack:[/b] Melee
[b]Move value:[/b] 2

[b]Special Ability:[/b] Start the game as Dr. Jekyll. At the start of your turn, you may transform into Dr. Jekyll or Mr. Hyde.
While Mr. Hyde: After you Maneuver, take 1 damage.

Baskerville Manor is a map for both 1v1 and 2v2 games with a special "Secret Passages" rule.

[b]Secret Passages:[/b]
Secret passages can be used by fighters to move quickly across the battlefield. Their occurrence depends on the map. These passages are indicated by the special icons on certain spaces. A fighter can move from one space with a secret passage to any other space with a secret passage as if they were adjacent.
Spaces with secret passages are not considered adjacent for any other purpose besides moving (e.g. fighters can’t attack through them).

What's more, [b]we prepared a very special reward for our Early Access players as a thank-you gift for being with us since the 15th of September - a special set of skins that will be granted for free only to Early Access players![/b] (More details about the reward as well as a release date soon!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/db88ac8af6bc36e4b04fc4386df0b2943300af52.png[/img]

[b]Additionally, let's dwell on the past and see what have we accomplished since the Early Access release!
[/b]
Since the start of Early Access on the 15th of September, the game has been [b]updated 7 times[/b]! [b]Let's see the biggest changes that were part of these patches!
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/ad79abf74458ce78cb0820879de18436b46103f8.png[/img]

[h2]1. Overall AI improvements! 🤖 [/h2]
Our AI had a tough time fighting all of you in September - you gave it quite a challenge! Since day one we were constantly improving our AI - making it smarter and better at playing Unmatched. We also taught it even more Unmatched rules and details like you don't boost maneuver with Excalibur or use it to defeat a 1HP Harpy. ;) You know... just pro plays like that. That is also your success - your feedback helped us immensely!  From what we hear from you in the comments on Steam, Facebook, Discord, and Twitter - you see and like these artificial opponents a lot! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/2a9008ff739a4bac5e12d7150361c4bfb9a36c7d.png[/img]

[h2]2. Increased speed of fight animation! ⏩ [/h2]
Many of our players were asking for speeding up the fight animation. We increased in once but that was not enough since the questions for this feature were still piling up! In the last patch, we think we satisfied our most competitive player's need for speed. ;) Once the speed slider in the settings is set up to the maximum the combat goes almost instantaneously! Test it yourself! :D 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/ba58ad6811404c9532a6b0fa11cd143b604ec451.png[/img]

[h2]3. "Discard" and "Hand" labels on the cards! 🃏 [/h2]
That is another feature you were asking us about a lot. Since the very last update, you can see labels informing you how many cards were discarded or revealed in the opponent's hand while scrolling through the decklist tab! :D Information is power and we want you to have everything presented as clearly as possible. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/9dff038fd0d44981df73479b9b36dcf184b4ed2b.png[/img]

[h2]4. Live Game mode for online multiplayer! ⏰ [/h2]
From the beginning, one of the things you were asking us about was waiting for an opponent to make their move. The previous default option for time limit was "No limit" - this was working great for our previous productions which were not focused on dynamic combat as much as Unmatched is! We met the expectations of Unmatched's players and added Live Game mode in which players have up to 5 minutes to make their move and if one of them leaves the room - he or she forfeits the match!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/4becd2138cd204ae8dc3c77d8e960ca22cb63b92.png[/img]

[h2]5. Adding the "Random Hero" and the "Random Map" in online multiplayer settings! 👥 [/h2]
In early versions of the game while creating an online game you could choose a "Random Hero" but it was drawn in the room which from your opponent's perspective was no different from selecting a specific hero. We changed that in a way that the "Random Hero" is unknown until the game begins. We also threw in the "Random Map" setting in the same update! Now nobody will accuse you of always selecting Medusa - that's just luck! ;) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853145/a1b2dba6f77ab1e6b448e3c307d55bab0e89bf35.png[/img]


That is all... for now! ;) Expect more updates in 2023! We are constantly working on Unmatched: Digital Edition to deliver you the best digital adaptation of this amazing board game we can think of! More features and updates will be added to the game on regular basis! As for leaving the Early Access - it will happen in Q1 2023 but we will announce the precise date after our Winter break which lasts from today to the 10th of January 2023. Since we won't be able to reply to your comments before that time - Happy New Year 2023 in advance! ;)

And for the scale of the updates we made below we are presenting a combined changelog from all of the updates! A lot of these issues were reported by you - our players! Can you spot your bug report or feature request on the list? ;) Let us know in the comments!

notes.title: Unmatched: Digital Edition update 0.5.4 is here!
notes.content:
We just released an update! :D Check out what has changed!

[Feature] Random character has been added as a choice in online games.
[Feature] Random map has been added as a choice in online games.
[Feature] Random heroes and maps are hidden until the game has started.
[Feature] The fight phase has been adjusted to match 16:10 screens.
[Feature] Animation has been added to the cards left in hand after accepting attack/defense.
[Feature] AI speed has been increased.
[Fix] Alice's special ability tooltip display in 2v2 matches has been fixed.
[Fix] Last played card is no longer displayed on a defeat screen.
[Fix] Issue causing the 2v2 online games to occasionally crash while AI was attacking a human player has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the card draw animation to not be displayed in 2v2 online games has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the cards in hand to be wrongly displayed after skipping the replay has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the game to occasionally crash after playing Alice's Looking Glass card has been fixed.
[Fix] Replay function is now working correctly during drawing Voyage cards from the discard pile.
[Fix] Issue causing the error message to be displed after trying to join the online room has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the card in hand to disappear after skipping the defense has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the card to be oversized after changing the resolution during the game has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the played card to return to hand after playing the Winged Frenzy card has been fixed.
[Fix] Help notifications during the fight phase have been fixed.
[Fix] Few minor errors in the graphics of the rulebook and lobby have been fixed.
[Fix] Text of the header of the statistic screen has been corrected.
[Fix] Hero's graphics placement in the character selection screen has been slightly corrected.
[Fix] Issue causing the player's name to not be displayed before choosing a hero has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the maneuver to not refresh the board correctly after undoing the action has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the cards in hand to disappear for a short second after selecting the defense card has been fixed.
[Fix] Main Menu and Lobby buttons during gameplay pause have been made easier to click.
[Fix] Issue causing the attacker's card animation to be displayed on the defender's card has been fixed.

!!! Due to updating some server features option "receive email notification" has been turned off for a while. If you would like to receive email notifications then please go to settings and check that checkbox again. :)

notes.title: Unmatched: Digital Edition update 0.5.3 is here!
notes.content:
We just released an update! :D Check out what has changed!

[Feature] We implemented changes to AI difficulty modes to be even more different from each other than before!
[Fix] Issues with achievements were fixed!
[Fix] Issue causing the game to freeze on AI turn has been fixed in most cases. We are still investigating the problem to completely remove it from the game but it's almost gone at this moment.
[Fix] Issue with the "Looking Glass" card has been fixed. Now if Alice is defeated in a fight in which that card was played only viable option is "draw 2 cards".
[Fix] Medusa AI processing speed was increased.
[Fix] Issue causing the cards to turn white for a split second after being played has been fixed.
[Fix] Issues with minimalizing tab with the opponent's card during the fight have been fixed.
[Fix] Global chat has been fixed!
[Fix] Issue causing the messages on chat to be displayed in reversed order has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the long username to cover online status in online games has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the username to be incorrectly displayed in online games has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the newly drawn card to disappear has been fixed in a few cases. We are still investigating the problem to completely remove it from the game.
[Fix] Issue with animation during drawing the first card as the first player has been fixed.
[Fix] Issues with buttons on the "See our other games" screen were fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the player to be unable to leave the online room before selecting a character has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the notifications option selection in account settings were not updated has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the hints during a fight to be wrongly displayed has been fixed.

notes.title: Unmatched: Digital Edition update 0.5.2 is here!
notes.content:
We just released an update! :D Check out what has changed!

[Feature] Information about Live Game mode is now displayed when creating an online game.
[Feature] Information about Live Game settings has been added to the Rulebook.
[Feature] Information about DLC characters has been unlocked in the Rulebook.
[Feature] Sound effect while placing sidekicks on the board has been added.
[Feature] New soundtrack was added to the game.
[Feature] Tooltips have been added to buttons on the right side of the main menu screen.
[Feature] Tooltips have been added to buttons in the pause menu.
[Feature] Tooltip has been added to Alice's special ability.
[Feature] Click sound has been added while moving to the next tutorial textbox.
[Feature] In-game notification informing about transforming inactive players to AI has been added.
[Feaure] Arrows in the map selection screen can be now clicked to change maps.
[Feature] Notifications informing about finishing the Tutorial's chapters have been added.
[Feature] "Close" button in the fight screen is now animated.
[Fix] Issues with revealing cards in the opponent's hand have been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the game to crash while transforming inactive players to AI has been fixed.
[Fix] Achievement for playing the Feint card has been fixed.
[Fix] Issues with boosting Medusa's Second Shot card have been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the game to crash while discarding random cards has been fixed.
[Fix] Issues with AI have been fixed - it is more stable right now.
[Fix] Issue causing the card to disappear during picking the defense card has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue with visibility of cards taken to hand from the Discard Pile has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the game to crash while the opponent was discarding cards has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the card to disappear after boosting King Arthur's attack has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the game to reload during the replay has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the game to crash after discarding the last card in hand has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the rooms in the lobby to not load properly has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the Player's Information screen not to update in real-time has been fixed.
[Fix] Volume issues have been fixed.
[Fix] Moving map with cursor has been improved.
[Fix] Issue causing the online game to crash when another player left the game has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the game to crash when starting the online game has been fixed.
[Fix] Social media buttons are now clickable.
[Fix] Issue causing the card to stay indefinitely zoomed has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the zoomed card to disappear has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the opponent's card to be hidden for the entire fight has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the confirmation button to not work properly when resolving card effects has been fixed.

notes.title: Unmatched: Digital Edition update 0.5.1 is here!
notes.content:
We just released an update! :D Check out what has changed!

[Feature] Default online game mode has been changed from "No limit" to "48 hours".
[Fix] Issue causing the sidekick to skip turns once the hero has been defeated has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the game to crash after King Arthur's boost has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the UI to disappear once the window with fight details was closed has been fixed.
[Fix] "By the fortune and fate" card is now named correctly.

notes.content:

[Fix] Hiding the opponent's card in the Tutorial has been fixed.
[Fix] Prophecy card has been fixed.
[Fix] Prophecy card is now displayed correctly.
[Fix] Issue causing 2v2 games to freeze after defeating one of the AI players has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the game to freeze after dealing damage to the opponent has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the game to freeze during sending feedback has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the online game to freeze after playing "Voyage to the Valley of the Giant Snakes" card has been fixed.
[Fix] Issue causing the game to freeze after playing "Maxnome Foe" card with no card in the deck has been fixed.

[Fix] The upper panel of the interface is now displayed correctly while skipping the replay.
[Fix] Issue causing the game to freeze (and crash in some instances) after skipping replay has been fixed.
